item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate whether declared source dependencies changed.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical(state):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a canonical JSON representation without altering *state*.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        state,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n        allow_nan=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return review status and sorted changed declared source paths.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", ()))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    changed = []\\n    for path in set(request.get(\\\"declared\\\", ())):\\n        if path in ignored:\\n            continue\\n        saved_state = saved[path] if path in saved else _MISSING\\n        current_state = current[path] if path in current else _MISSING\\n        if _canonical(saved_state) != _canonical(current_state):\\n            changed.append(path)\\n\\n    changed.sort()\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
